liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Casey Jones** (1 review): Reviewer enjoys how Casey Jones sounded in 1973 [18]
- **Clear the Aisles** (1 review): Part one of Clear the Aisles contains what the reviewer calls the best banter ever [13]
- **Mississippi Half-Step** (1 other source): Noodling segue from Mississippi Half-Step into Playin' in the Band is kept intact across discs [1]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Final minutes of Uncle John's Band feature prominent Phil, feedback and space [13]
- **Playin' in the Band** (1 review): Playin' > Uncle John's Band > Playin' sequence is a reviewer favorite, once aired on Dead Hour [12]

## Setlist highlights

- **Blue Suede Shoes//**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [23]
- **Workingman's Blues**: back after 194 archived shows (848 days); rare: 14 archived performances [23]
- **Clear the Aisles**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [23]
- **Clear the Aisles**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-12-01.sbd.clugston.6648.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 31 songs; 205 min; rated 4.33/5 by 9 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard is clear and crisp; reviewer hopes Charlie Miller remasters it; Soundboard quality is very good; reviewer wants a Charlie Miller remaster; Brief one-second burst of static occurs around 4:01 into Big River [1][13][17]
- **gd1973-12-01.sbd.miller.112205.flac16**: soundboard; 28 songs; 226 min; rated 3.6/5 by 10 [2]
- **gd1973-12-01.aud.degen.110781.flac1644**: audience recording; 29 songs; 198 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [6]. Said about its sound: This transfer sounds noticeably better than the reviewer remembers from early-80s cassette copies [19]
- **gd1973-12-01.aud.maloney.98049.flac16**: audience recording; 25 songs; 234 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [7]
- **gd73-12-01.aud.vernon.18094.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 167 min; rated 1/5 by 4 [9]. Said about its sound: Audience recording judged awful in quality; reviewer wouldn't play it for coworkers and wants a better source; Audience tape sounds horrid, a reason taper sections were later introduced; reviewer asks for a soundboard [11][12]

## Around the show

- Police tried clearing people from aisles; their leader walked on stage waving arms and lights came up, but band kept playing [16]
- Attendee sat eighth row, dead center, with tickets obtained through a music-business acquaintance's father [16]
- Reviewer guesses the first three tracks are a soundcheck, though admits not attending [17]
- Uploader saw the Dead in Bangor, Maine in April 1971, a more music-focused crowd than this show [3]
- Uploader found the crowd experience very different from expectations, realizing he was a fan rather than a Deadhead [3]
- Reviewer regrets the Playin' > Uncle John's > Playin' wasn't on the Dick's Picks covering the nights before and after [12]
- Reviewer concedes it doesn't match some other nights but remains a personal favorite [16]
- Show seems overlooked, perhaps because it falls between two Dick's Picks releases [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-12-01.sbd.clugston.6648.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Master Soundboard Reels > PCM > DAT> CDR [1]. Also: Four-disc set could fit on three discs, but that would split the Half-Step into Playin' segue [1]
- **gd1973-12-01.sbd.miller.112205.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [2]. Also: Disc changes are seamless and can be moved to fit the show onto three discs [2]
- **gd1973-12-01.aud.degen.110781.flac1644**: taped by Bill Degen. This transfer is 1st Gen cassettes, kindly provided by Tim Friend.; transferred by Transfer by Andrew F.; source: FOB AUD Source: Unknown equipment > MAC. [6]. Also: Audience source comes from Bill Degen's reels, which the reviewer heard on cassettes in the early 80s [19]
- **gd1973-12-01.aud.maloney.98049.flac16**: source: AUDIENCE ANALOG MASTER>CDR [7]. Also: Recording credited to Joe Maloney; uploader asks that it not be remastered and reposted [7]
- **gd73-12-01.aud.vernon.18094.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Matt Vernon and Marc Pujol; source: Audience Recording [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by arizjones.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead, Boston Music Hall 12-01-1973 (SBD)](https://arizjones.blogspot.com/2015/06/grateful-dead-boston-music-hall-12-01.html) [24]
